sumInsured: As per Policy Schedule (not provided in extract)

great.name: Room rent: No limit (default/base benefit)
great.quote: The eligible Room Rent or Room Category applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on Room Charges incurred towards stay during Hospitalization
great.explanation: No room category restriction in the base policy, which helps avoid room-rent linked deductions.

great.name: ICU charges: No limit
great.quote: The eligible ICU Charges applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on ICU Charges incurred towards stay in ICU during Hospitalization.
great.explanation: ICU stay is not capped separately, reducing the risk of large out-of-pocket costs in critical care.

great.name: Restore benefit: Unlimited Automatic Recharge (same & different illness; unlimited times)
great.quote: automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year... (iii) Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness as well as different Illnesses.
great.explanation: If you exhaust the base SI (and listed buffers), the policy can recharge the base SI unlimited times within the same policy year, including for the same illness.

great.name: Built-in Additional Sum Insured buffer: Plus Benefit (activates after base SI exhaustion)
great.quote: An additional amount as specified in the Policy Schedule will be available... (d) The Plus Benefit will be applicable only after exhaustion of Base Sum Insured.
great.explanation: Provides extra cover once base SI is used up (amount depends on what you choose in the schedule).

great.name: NCB/Renewal Bonus: 50% per year and does not reduce on claim (Cumulative Bonus)
great.quote: enhance the Sum Insured by 50% flat, on a cumulative basis... (vi) In the event of a Claim there is no impact on the accrual of Cumulative Bonus.
great.explanation: Your bonus grows by 50% per claim-free policy year (up to 100% cap) and the policy wording says claims do not impact accrual.

great.name: Modern treatments covered (listed advanced technology methods) under hospitalization
great.quote: The Company will indemnify... for expenses incurred... for treatment taken through following advance technology methods: ... Robotic surgeries ... Stereotactic radio surgeries ... Immunotherapy- Monoclonal Antibody ... Stem cell therapy: Hematopoietic stem cells for bone marrow transplant...
great.explanation: Coverage includes a defined list of modern/advanced procedures under hospitalization expenses.

great.name: Domiciliary hospitalization covered (treatment at home when medically necessary)
great.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person, only through Reimbursement Facility... towards Domiciliary Hospitalization
great.explanation: Home-treatment (domiciliary) is covered when it meets the defined conditions (e.g., typically >3 consecutive days).

good.name: PED waiting period (base): 36 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage, which is within normal industry range.

good.name: Specific illness (Named Ailment) waiting period (base): 24 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...
good.explanation: Named ailments are covered after 24 months (standard).

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days (non-accident)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting period for illness; accidents are excluded from this waiting.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization: 60 days
good.quote: For a period of 60 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission to the Hospital
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for the same condition up to 60 days before admission (reimbursement only).

good.name: Post-hospitalization: 180 days
good.quote: For a period of 180 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge from the hospital
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for the same condition up to 180 days after discharge (reimbursement only).

good.name: Optional cover trade-off: Smart Select (premium discount; 20% co-pay only outside Annexure III hospitals)
good.quote: If this Optional Benefit is opted... reduction in the total premium... If the Insured Person takes Medical Treatment in hospitals other than those listed in Annexure – III... shall bear a Co-Payment of 20% on each and every Claim... However, no such additional co-payment shall be applicable if treatment is availed in the hospitals listed in Annexure III
good.explanation: Optional discounted variant: co-pay applies only if you opt for Smart Select and go to non-listed hospitals.

bad.name: Consumables / non-medical items not covered by default (unless Claim Shield optional benefit is taken)
bad.quote: Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure – I to Policy Terms & Conditions).
bad.explanation: Common consumables/non-medical items (e.g., gloves, masks, nebulization kits, etc. listed in Annexure I) are excluded by default and can lead to out-of-pocket costs unless covered via an optional benefit (e.g., Claim Shield).

unclear.name: Co-pay (base policy): whether any mandatory co-pay applies (when optional co-pay is NOT opted)
unclear.quote: The Co-payment proportion ( If opted ) shall be borne by the Insured Person on each Claim
unclear.reference: General Conditions Applicable To All The Benefits, point 4 and Clause 3.2.7
unclear.explanation: Wording clearly says co-pay applies if opted, but the extract does not explicitly confirm '0% co-pay by default' or list any default co-pay in the base plan. Verify in your Policy Schedule.

unclear.name: Cashless network size (number of network hospitals)
unclear.quote: Network Provider ... means the Hospitals enlisted by an Insurer, TPA or jointly by an Insurer and TPA to provide medical services to an Insured by a Cashless Facility.
unclear.explanation: The document defines network providers and cashless process but does not state the total network hospital count. Confirm current network size on the insurer website/app.
